title: Richmond Rent Control 2026: What Landlords Must Know About the Richmond Fair Rent Act

findings.quote: A single-family rental in Richmond doesn't get a rent cap
findings.root_cause: The draft generalizes a local exemption to all law; the checklist and FAQ repeat this. Civil Code 1947.12 can apply to locally exempt housing. Source: https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=1947.12.
findings.fix: Use 'not subject to Richmond's local rent cap'; add a separate AB 1482 eligibility check, including ownership and exemption-notice conditions for separately alienable homes and the rolling 15-year construction exemption.
findings.future_prevention: Record the local-versus-state distinction in Richmond coverage knowledge.

findings.quote: Base Rent + AGA = Maximum Allowable Rent
findings.root_cause: This treats a percentage as a dollar amount and omits accumulated lawful adjustments. The body also implies today's AGA alone applied to original Base Rent establishes MAR. Source: https://www.ci.richmond.ca.us/3376/Rent-Increase
findings.fix: Replace the formula with an explanation that MAR depends on lawful rent history and applicable adjustments; link the city's MAR calculator. Distinguish the ordinary current AGA from available banking.
findings.future_prevention: Require a worked, verified calculation before publishing rent formulas.

findings.quote: 30 days for an increase of 10% or less, 90 days for anything larger
findings.root_cause: The summary omits the cumulative prior-12-month test and additional mailing time, and reads as universal despite statutory exceptions. Source: https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=827.
findings.fix: Say generally at least 30/90 days based on cumulative increases over the preceding 12 months, account for service by mail and applicable exceptions, and link section 827 directly. More notice does not authorize an otherwise unlawful increase.
findings.future_prevention: Add a notice-summary regression check for aggregation and service method.

findings.quote: Run through this before serving any AGA increase notice:
findings.root_cause: The action checklist omits the Rent Program brochure and annual Rental Housing Fee compliance, although both appear in current city instructions. Source: https://www.ci.richmond.ca.us/3376/Rent-Increase
findings.fix: Add brochure service and paid Rental Housing Fee checks; clarify that enrollment must be amended when ownership/contact/agent/status changes, despite not being an annual renewal.
findings.future_prevention: Maintain a current source-linked AGA notice checklist.

findings.quote: the first time in years the two have swapped places
findings.root_cause: Historical comparison was inferred from the prior cycle. Richmond's 2024 AGA was 1.4%, below Oakland's 2.3%. Sources: https://www.ci.richmond.ca.us/3376/Rent-Increase and https://www.oaklandca.gov/Community/Housing-Programs-Support/For-Landlords/Allowable-Rent-Increases/Learn-More-About-Allowable-Rent-Increases
findings.fix: Replace all longstanding-higher/first-time claims with a comparison limited to 2025–26 versus 2026–27. Keep the practical warning to check each city's current rate.
findings.future_prevention: Verify both historical series before writing trend-based hooks.

findings.root_cause: The city's Billing page distinguishes annual registration for 3+ units from every three years for 1–2; its RRIP update page says yearly for participants. The knowledge file also contains both versions. Sources: https://www.ci.richmond.ca.us/4832/Billing and https://www.ci.richmond.ca.us/2101/Rental-Inspection-Program
findings.fix: Resolve using the enacted amendment/current fee schedule or department confirmation. Until resolved, omit the universal frequency assertion or explicitly disclose the conflict. Re-verify FY 2025–26 tax/fee amounts for the 2026–27 publication; don't infer a new fee from a stale page.
findings.future_prevention: Reconcile the contradictory RRIP entries and track fee verification by fiscal year.

findings.quote: No equivalent city-run rental inspection program
findings.root_cause: A broad negative comparison has no supporting Oakland inspection-program source in the article or this review.
findings.fix: Narrow to the specific recurring RRIP model and verify against Oakland's inspection programs, or remove this row.
